label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: TGL Historic Trade
items.text: Boston Common Golf traded for Shane Lowry, reuniting him with Rory McIlroy for the 2027 season in the first player trade in TGL history.

items.headline: TGL Expands Roster
items.text: The indoor golf league co-founded by Tiger Woods expands to 35 players and seven teams for its third season starting in 2026-27.

items.headline: Grant Thornton Teams Set
items.text: The official 16 teams of LPGA and PGA Tour stars are announced for the 2026 Grant Thornton Invitational.
